    Fast arbitrary-length DCT-II/III for v1.1.2
    
    Replace the quadratic NPO2 DCT-II/III fallback with an FFT-backed
    O(N log N) embedding. Even lengths pack through an N/2 real DFT;
    odd lengths use an N-point FFT. FFTW unnormalized REDFT10/01
    scaling is unchanged, and a length-257 DCT stays length 257.
    
    Add conjugate-pair codelets (7, 11, 13, 17, 19, 43) plus CT
    leaves 9/15/21/27. The planner peels the largest codelet factor
    so 513 is 27×19 and packed 129/258 go through 43. Mixed-radix
    3/5/7 columns stay SIMD.
